name: Final L5 anatomical rigid registration
external_development: All six previously scored external broad-holdout cases, no s0010 used for tuning.
external_semantics: Observed-coordinate-only left TP and SAP geometric proxies; old all-bone A0 unchanged. Only synthetic previous broad partial-geometry pattern, no simulated US.

fit.selection: Tune A2 OTHER_BONE weight on the six external development cases. Rank A1 and best A2 by all-case hidden coverage within 1.5 mm, then lower union P95, then prefer A1. Within A2 exact ties favor smaller weight. Freeze before evaluation.

evaluation.local_error_measure: P95 maximum of CT-local-to-fit-local and fit-local-to-CT-local. Clip both face sets by triangle centroid within the frozen ROI. Report medians separately. Use corresponding inferred vertices across sessions in evaluator CT RAS and union local ROI support.
evaluation.external_pass_rule: On reserved anatomies, require higher pooled all-case coverage within 1.5 mm and lower all-case hidden forward P95 than A0, with observations retained after abstention.
evaluation.decision: PASS if all gates pass. PARTIAL requires more accepted U-Net fits than A0 and improved U-Net cortical path coverage but remaining failed or unavailable gates. FAIL otherwise.
evaluation.consistency_gate_cohort: Accepted distinct 102-waypoint sessions only; report all 126-waypoint pairs and the shared original prefix separately.
